description.zh: 反应快慢取决于单位时间里有多少次“成功碰撞”——碰得越勤、能量越过门槛的比例越大，反应就越快；提高浓度、升温、磨成粉末、加催化剂，改的都是这两件事之一。
description.en: How fast a reaction goes depends on how many successful collisions happen per unit time — more frequent collisions and a larger share clearing the energy threshold make it faster; raising concentration, heating, powdering a solid and adding a catalyst each change one of these two things.

en: why does heating speed up a reaction
why does a powder react faster
how does a catalyst speed up a reaction

label.zh: 温度就是粒子跑得多快
label.en: Temperature is how fast the particles move

reason.zh: 粒子与物态页把温度读成粒子热运动的剧烈程度；升温让粒子跑得更快，于是碰撞更勤，也有更多碰撞的能量越过门槛。
reason.en: The particles lesson reads temperature as how wildly particles move; warming makes them faster, so they collide more often and more of those collisions carry enough energy to clear the threshold.

label.en: The quantitative version of the threshold

reason.zh: 碰撞理论数出越过门槛的碰撞；活化能页把这道门槛记作 Eₐ，用 k = A·e^(−Eₐ/RT) 算出越过门槛的比例怎样随温度指数式增长。
reason.en: Collision theory counts the collisions that clear the threshold; the activation-energy lesson names the threshold Eₐ and uses k = A·e^(−Eₐ/RT) to show how the fraction clearing it grows exponentially with temperature.

reason.zh: 知道速率是成功碰撞的次数，就能理解可逆反应：生成物越多，逆向碰撞也越多，直到正、逆两个速率相等，宏观组成不再变化。
reason.en: Once a rate is a count of successful collisions, reversible reactions make sense: as products build up, reverse collisions become more frequent until the forward and reverse rates match and the composition stops changing.
